subject: Exec approval needed: SuccessPack + custom connector discount for OrthoBridge
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Anna Rudd <anna.rudd@orthobridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal and SuccessPack options for OrthoBridge

Hi Anna —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Attached is the SOW (v1) and the standard SuccessPack pricing sheet (RB-pricing-breakdown-OB.xlsx). The proposal includes:
- SuccessPack (6 months Premium Support, onboarding runbook, monthly QBRs)
- 20 dev-hours for a one-off connector (line-item)

Per our standard terms the connector is quoted at $240/hr and onboarding is bundled at list price. If you want to reduce the price, we can propose a promotional discount or include fewer dev hours in the fixed price.

Please review and let me know if you want me to open this with Deal Desk for a bundled discount and nonstandard SLA.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment(s): OrthoBridge_SOW_v1.pdf, RB-pricing-breakdown-OB.xlsx

From: Anna Rudd <anna.rudd@orthobridge.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal and SuccessPack options for OrthoBridge

Soojin —

Thanks for the materials. Quick ask from our side: we need the one-off connector to our legacy scheduling system (details in connector_spec_draft.md) and would like the fixed scope to include 12 dev-hours rather than 20. Also, because we are committed to a 12-month contract, can Redwood consider a 25% discount on the SuccessPack bundle and a 99.9% SLA for the premium tier? Procurement will need formal confirmation.

If you can escalate this for approval, I can get procurement engaged immediately.

Thanks,
Anna
VP Product, OrthoBridge
procurement@orthobridge.com

---
Anna Rudd
OrthoBridge
attachment: connector_spec_draft.md

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Rudd <anna.rudd@orthobridge.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Deal Desk escalation: OrthoBridge — 25% discount + 12 dev-hrs for connector (needs exec signoff)

Team —

OrthoBridge (target close Q2) has asked for a 25% discount on the SuccessPack and to reduce the connector scope to a fixed 12 dev-hours (they want the work included in the SOW). They are committing to a 12-month contract which helps economics, but this is outside of standard terms for bundled discounts and SLA (they want 99.9%).

Key details:
- ACV (baseline): $180k/yr list
- SuccessPack list: $36k/yr
- Proposed discount: 25% on SuccessPack ($9k annual reduction)
- Connector: quoted 20 hrs @ $240 = $4,800; Anna requests 12 fixed hours bundled.
- Net new ARR impact year 1: ~ -$9k + shifted services margin on connector

Attachments: SOW v1, pricing calc.

Ask: Exec approval for 25% off SuccessPack + exception to include 12 dev-hours in SOW at fixed price. If approved, I'll update the SOW and send redlines to procurement.

Thanks — Soojin

Attachment(s): OrthoBridge_SOW_v1.pdf, RB-pricing-breakdown-OB.xlsx, connector_spec_draft.md

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Anna Rudd <anna.rudd@orthobridge.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deal Desk escalation: OrthoBridge — 25% discount + 12 dev-hrs for connector (needs exec signoff)

Soojin —

I support moving this forward but recommend we limit the discount to 15% unless finance confirms the unit economics hold. The 12 dev-hrs being built into the SOW is reasonable as a one-off for strategic logos in this segment.

Aditya — please confirm margin impact and whether 25% is acceptable from a finance perspective. If not, we push 15% and offer 4 complimentary hours of professional services to get to their target effort.

Ben
VP Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deal Desk escalation: OrthoBridge — 25% discount + 12 dev-hrs for connector (needs exec signoff)

Team —

Given OrthoBridge's strategic fit (regional health customer, potential platform reference) and their 12-month commitment, I approve the following exceptions:
1) 25% discount on SuccessPack for year 1 only (standard pricing thereafter)
2) Include 12 dev-hours for the connector at a capped fixed fee equal to 12 * $240 (no carve-outs)
3) We will not change the SLA in contracts beyond our standard premium SLA wording; commit to operational runbook and QBR cadence instead of a custom 99.9% SLA commitment.

Soojin — proceed to update the SOW and procurement packets. Finance (Aditya) to update the pricing calc and confirm reporting. Ben — capture the approval thread in Deal Desk and mark the deal as Exec-Approved.

Vivek
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Anna Rudd <anna.rudd@orthobridge.com>, procurement@orthobridge.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T09:37:00-07:00
Subject: Approved: SuccessPack discount + connector scope — next steps

Anna —

Good news: Execs have approved a one-time 25% discount on the SuccessPack for year 1 and the inclusion of 12 dev-hours for the connector at a capped fee (12 * $240). We cannot commit to a custom 99.9% SLA, but we will deliver the premium SuccessPack deliverables, a detailed operational runbook, and monthly QBRs as part of the agreement.

Next steps:
- I'll update SOW v1 with the approved pricing and connector scope and send for your redlines by EOD tomorrow.
- Procurement: once redlines are agreed, we will issue a DocuSign for signature.
- Aditya will post the finalized pricing to HubSpot and mark the deal Exec-Approved.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
